newsitem.title: CANADA: Man damages Indonesian consulate in Canada.
newsitem.headline: Man damages Indonesian consulate in Canada.

text.p: A man upset about losing his job damaged furniture and artifacts at the Indonesian consulate in Toronto on Monday, police said on Tuesday.
"He went a little berserk inside the place yesterday and did about C$10,000 worth of damage inside," Toronto Police Detective Doug Dunstan said.
Dunstan said the suspect was upset after being fired on Monday from his job as a driver and handyman at the consulate.
Dunstan dismissed rumors that the incident was related to the high-profile Bre-X Minerals Ltd saga in Indonesia.
"There is no connection there as far as I can see. I questioned him about that and he just laughed at me," Dunstan said.
I guess with the whole thing about Bre-X and everything else, this happening just sort of gets people's minds working, conspiracy theories," he added.
Yusnan Poerba, 48, was charged with two offenses that protect internationally protected people and premises.
Poerba came to Canada from Indonesia about 1974 and had immigrant status, the detective said.
